cohort: 356 newborns hospitalized in neonatal intensive care units at general hospitals in Eastern Ethiopia between January and December 2019.
finding: The overall prevalence of neonatal sepsis was 45.8%, and it was associated with prolonged rupture of membrane, vaginal delivery, low APGAR score, prelacteal feeding, and mechanical ventilation.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with an increased risk of neonatal sepsis (AOR = 1.78, 95%, CI: [1.09, 2.96]).
